lines.text: The boy Samuel served the LORD before Eli and lay down in the temple where the ark was.
The LORD called Samuel three times, and each time he went to Eli, who realized it was the LORD.
Eli told Samuel to say, "Speak, LORD, for Your servant is listening," and the LORD came and stood there calling.
The LORD told Samuel He would judge Elkanah's house forever, and its iniquity would never be atoned for by sacrifice.
All Israel from Dan to Beersheba knew Samuel was a prophet, and the LORD kept appearing at Bethel.
